text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the library, I catch a<n>glimpse of Sweep
Tosho combing the<n>shelves for something.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I found it! This is definitely it. I knew I<n>saw it the last
time I was here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph, Grandma tells me that all the<n>time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I gotta hurry before<n>she catches
up!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Thorns, o thorns, entwine! ☆

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: I've finally found you, Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What gives?! Why isn't my<n>ensnaring spell
working?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see your trainer is with you as<n>well. Let me
explain.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho didn't do her<n>homework, and when I
tried to get her<n>to attend makeup lessons, she ran
away.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Of course I did! Who would want tostay at school for that?! If I don'twanna, I don't wanna!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, why isn't my spell<n>working?! I'm sure I
followed all the<n>steps in this book!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho, hear me out. I'm not<n>giving you
homework so you have<n>more busywork to do.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
In your future as a competitor,<n>balancing training
with your studies<n>will be very important. That's
why<n>I'm giving you homework now, so<n>you can get
used to it.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Blah blah blah—who are you to give<n>me orders?! If I
don't wanna, I'm not<n>gonna!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Clearly, these two have forgotten to<n>use their inside
voices. Sensing the<n>judging stares of those around
us, I<n>realize it's my time to intervene.
choice_data_list:
Sorry for the trouble. Perhaps I could talk to Sweep
if you don't mind?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Back in my office, I suggest to Sweep<n>Tosho that
maybe doing her<n>homework wouldn't be so bad.
Heck,<n>it might even be fun!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Homework, schomework—even my<n>familiar's
getting on my case now! I<n>thought you were helping
me by<n>getting that teacher outta my hair!
choice_data_list: You can't just not do your homework.
You can't just not do your homework.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Then why don't you do it for me,familiar?!
choice_data_list: You know I can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And why not?! A familiar HAS tolisten to their master, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
There's no stopping her once she's<n>throwing a
tantrum. She's completely<n>honest with her feelings,
and has no<n>patience for things she isn't<n>interested
in.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In a sudden flash of genius, I recall a<n>recent
moment when she showed a<n>liking to something.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I found it! This is definitely it. I knew I<n>saw it the last
time I was here!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, what're you all quiet for?
choice_data_list:
Why don't you just do your homework with
magic?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You mean like writing the<n>answers with
magic? Hmm, you<n>might be onto something.
choice_data_list:
I guess that could work, but what about casting a
spell on yourself?

I guess that could work, but what about casting a
spell on yourself?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Casting a spell on myself? Explain,<n>familiar.
choice_data_list:
You know, like a spell to help you solve problems
faster!

You know, like a spell to help you solve problems
faster!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that just extra steps though? So<n>basically...
you want me to cast a<n>speed spell, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well... whatever. Sounds kinda fun!<n>Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Spell well—excel! Alstroemeria! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, now for the first problem...<n>Wow, it really is a
piece of cake now!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As if truly enchanted, Sweep begins<n>to plow
through her homework at an<n>impressive pace.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
For this problem... Urgh, I can feel my<n>speed
dropping! "Solve like the wind!<n>Alstroemeria! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I can't believe I'm already<n>done! Do you see
now, familiar? This<n>is the power of Magical Girl
Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When she makes up her mind to do<n>something, she
really does do it better<n>than anyone else.
choice_data_list: Your magic is out of this world!
Your magic is out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, praise me more! I can't wait to<n>shut that
teacher up! C'mon, let's go<n>find her—I bet she'll be
shocked!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
A perfect score. Good grief, I knew<n>you could do it if
you applied yourself,<n>so please stop running away
all the<n>time. Also...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer helped you, right? Make<n>sure to say
thank you later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geeeeez! She should've been<n>stunned by my
magic—not fawning<n>over my familiar!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
In any case, with magic on my side,<n>homework is a
problem of the past.<n>Goodbye extra lessons, hello
freedom!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As she says that, her eyes light up<n>with newfound
motivation. When it<n>comes to doing what she loves,
you<n>won't find a harder worker than<n>Sweep Tosho.
